biotools.summary: FLIM Playground is an interactive, end-to-end graphical platform for single-cell analysis of fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy (FLIM) data. It unifies complex workflows, allowing users to extract features, perform data analysis, and visualize results without needing custom code.
